identity.name: Location
identity.definition: A geographic duty station where one or more federal positions are based.

structure.evidence: city, state, country, region, remoteEligible, activeListingCount, coordinates — sufficient for a detail page and map display.

instances.evidence: Washington DC; Fort Bragg, NC; Anchorage, AK.

purpose.evidence: Job seekers filter and browse by location to find positions near them or in a target city.

sipValidation.verdict: Valid object. Clear structure, named instances, and a primary navigation role in job discovery.

synonyms.notes: Formal term for the location where an employee is assigned to work.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: The two-letter state or territory code. Absent for international locations.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: A geographic grouping derived from state, used for regional filtering.

attributes.name: remoteEligible
attributes.description: Whether any active listings at this location are flagged as telework-eligible.

attributes.name: activeListingCount
attributes.description: Count of currently open Job Listings at this location. Computed at query time.

attributes.name: coordinates
attributes.description: Approximate latitude and longitude derived from city and state. Used for map display.

actions.name: Browse location listings
actions.description: Navigates to a filtered list of open Job Listings at this location.

actions.name: Share location page
actions.description: Copies or shares a direct URL to the location page.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Job Listings carry one or more location records that map to Location objects.
relationships.cardinality: one-to-many (one Location has many Job Listings; a high-demand location like Washington DC may have thousands)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: salary descending, grade descending, series alphabetical.
relationships.filters: Series, agency, grade, appointment type, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Optional for Location. A location can exist with zero active listings. Listings retain their location values if location data changes.

views.context: A Location in a browse or search context.
views.userIntent: Find locations with open positions relevant to them.

views.context: A Location detail page visited by a job seeker.
views.userIntent: Browse all open federal positions at a specific location.

stories.title: Job seeker finds all federal jobs in their city
stories.benefit: discovers all open federal positions near them without filtering by agency or series
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker wants to stay in a specific city or region
stories.thenClause: They see all active listings at that location across all agencies and series

businessRules.title: Remote positions may have no physical location
businessRules.description: A listing with teleworkEligible = true and no duty station records maps to no Location object. The redesign must handle this case without breaking the Location relationship.

businessRules.title: coordinates are approximate
businessRules.description: coordinates are derived from city and state and are not precise addresses. They are suitable for map display only.

businessRules.title: International locations omit state
businessRules.description: Locations outside the United States and territories do not have a state value.

states.name: Active
states.description: The location has or has had federal job listings.
states.triggers: A Job Listing references this location.
